text_elements.text: Disconnect the connector, and then remove the battery temperature sensor harness (rear).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Remove the harness clips of the voltage detection harness and the Li-ion battery heater harness from the harness bracket, and move them to a location where they do not inhibit with work.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Remove the mounting nuts and remove the high-voltage harness , from the rear module stack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: There is the danger of electric shock caused by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Because there is a risk of electric shock, immediately protect the disconnected high-voltage terminals with insulating tape so that they are not exposed.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Remove the rear module stack mounting bolts .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Follow the procedure below and remove the rear module stack from the battery pack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Attach  a  carabiner  to  position  (A)  as  shown  in  the  figure  and connect a lashing belt to it.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Use the engine frame (A) and lift up the rear module stack .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Do not move the engine crane when the rear module stack is lifted up.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Move the battery pack and place the workbench below the rear module stack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Place the removed battery pack upper case onto the battery pack for storage.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Place the rear module stack onto the workbench.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Because there is a risk of electric shock, lay an anti-static rubber sheet on the workbench.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: When replacing the Li-ion battery with a new battery, perform the following operation.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Enter the date of the (replacement) work on the EV battery tracking identification seal that is packaged together with the new part.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Cut the EV battery tracking identification tool into 2 pieces and apply them to the body of the replaced (old) LI-ion battery and to the 'Li-ion battery replacement history record'.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Enter the necessary information in the 'Li-ion battery replacement history record'.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Follow the following procedure and install the rear module stack onto the battery pack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Use the engine frame (A) and lift up the rear module stack .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Do not move the engine crane when the rear module stack is lifted up.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Move the workbench and place the battery pack below the rear module stack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Mount the rear module stack onto the battery pack.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: There is the danger of electric shock caused by contact with the terminals. Be sure to wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Because there is a risk of electric shock, immediately protect the disconnected high-voltage terminals with insulating tape so that they are not exposed.
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Install the voltage detection harness and the Li-ion battery heater harness .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Be sure to align the locating pin position.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Tighten the rear module stack mounting bolts .
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To  prevent  electric  shock,  wear  insulated  protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Install the battery temperature sensor harness (rear).
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: To prevent electric shock, wear insulated protective gear and use insulated tools.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Install the battery temperature sensor onto module No. MD12.
